                  deliverySpeed === 15
                    ? 'border-[#d4a24f] bg-[#fcf5e7] text-[#3d2711] font-bold shadow-xs'
                    : 'border-[#ebded0] bg-white text-[#66503b] hover:border-[#d4a24f]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="text-[11px]">⚡ 15秒</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#9c846f]">快速体验</div>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDeliverySpeed(35)}
                className={`py-2 px-1 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  deliverySpeed === 35
                    ? 'border-[#d4a24f] bg-[#fcf5e7] text-[#3d2711] font-bold shadow-xs'
                    : 'border-[#ebded0] bg-white text-[#66503b] hover:border-[#d4a24f]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="text-[11px]">🛵 35秒</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#9c846f]">逼真流速</div>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDeliverySpeed(90)}
                className={`py-2 px-1 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  deliverySpeed === 90
                    ? 'border-[#d4a24f] bg-[#fcf5e7] text-[#3d2711] font-bold shadow-xs'
                    : 'border-[#ebded0] bg-white text-[#66503b] hover:border-[#d4a24f]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="text-[11px]">⏱️ 90秒</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#9c846f]">真实沉浸</div>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step 4: Custom Note */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#45311c] mb-1">外卖小票留言：</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={customNote}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomNote(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="写一句关照TA的贴心话..."
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#ebded0] bg-white text-xs text-[#3d2711] focus:outline-hidden focus:border-[#d4a24f]"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Payment Bar */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-[#f9f3e9] border-t border-[#ebded0] flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8c745e]">外卖心意小计: </span>
            <span className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#ab6f1d] font-mono">
              ¥{selectedFood.price.toFixed(2)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleConfirmOrder}
            disabled={!selectedContact || validContacts.length === 0}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
              !selectedContact || validContacts.length === 0
                ? 'bg-stone-300 text-stone-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#e5c07b] to-[#cf9842] hover:from-[#dbae5e] hover:to-[#bd842f] active:scale-95 text-[#3b240e] cursor-pointer'
            }`}
          >
            <span>{selectedContact ? `立即送给 ${selectedContact.remark || selectedContact.name}` : '请先选择好友'}</span>
            <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface GameMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: 'gm' | 'player';
  text: string;
  timestamp: number;
  rollResult?: {
    type: string;
    roll: number;
    text: string;
  };
  fileAttachment?: {
    name: string;
    type: string;
    url?: string;
    contentPreview?: string;
  };
}

interface PlayerStats {
  location: string;
  atmosphere: string;
  name: string;
  gender: string;
  age: string;
  customStats: { name: string; value: number }[];
}

export const TheaterApp: React.FC<TheaterAppProps> = ({ settings, contacts, worldBooks, onBack }) => {
  // 1. 核心游戏状态
  const [selectedPreset, setSelectedPreset] = useState<CampaignPreset>(CAMPAIGN_PRESETS[0]);
  
  // 角色卡定制：姓名、性别、年龄
  const [playerName, setPlayerName] = useState(settings.userNickname || '探险者');
  const [playerGender, setPlayerGender] = useState('女');
  const [playerAge, setPlayerAge] = useState('18');
  const [customWorldDesc, setCustomWorldDesc] = useState('');

  // 玩家自定义的附加属性，如“名气值”等
  const [customStats, setCustomStats] = useState<{ name: string; value: number }[]>([]);
  const [newStatName, setNewStatName] = useState('');
  const [newStatValue, setNewStatValue] = useState('50');

  // 游戏进行状态
  const [gameState, setGameState] = useState<'list' | 'creating' | 'playing'>('list');
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<any[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('wephone_theater_sessions');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load theater game storage:', e);
      return [];
    }
  });
  const [currentSessionId, setCurrentSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isEditingSession, setIsEditingSession] = useState(false);
  const [currentEditingId, setCurrentEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [playerStats, setPlayerStats] = useState<PlayerStats | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<GameMessage[]>([]);
  const [inputVal, setInputVal] = useState('');
  const [dismissedErrorMsgId, setDismissedErrorMsgId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [toastMsg, setToastMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 骰子/宿命骰及属性已被移除
  const [showDicePanel, setShowDicePanel] = useState(false);
  const [selectedDiceType, setSelectedDiceType] = useState<'d6' | 'd20' | 'd100'>('d20');
  const [isRolling, setIsRolling] = useState(false);
  const [lastRoll, setLastRoll] = useState<{ roll: number; date: number } | null>(null);

  const [showResetConfirm, setShowResetConfirm] = useState(false);

  // 新增剧情数值与手动微调的轻量 UI 控制状态与保存/导出状态
  const [showActiveAddStat, setShowActiveAddStat] = useState(false);
  const [activeStatAddName, setActiveStatAddName] = useState('');
  const [activeStatAddValue, setActiveStatAddValue] = useState('50');
  const [showExportModal, setShowExportModal] = useState(false);

  // 文件上传
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [attachedFile, setAttachedFile] = useState<{
    name: string;
    type: string;
    dataUrl?: string;
    text?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // 2. 自动持久化 sessions
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('wephone_theater_sessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
    console.log('Saved sessions to localStorage:', sessions.length);
  }, [sessions]);

  // 3. 自动同步当前游戏数据到 sessions 列表 (实现全程自动保存)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentSessionId) return;
    
    setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => {
      if (s.id === currentSessionId) {
        return {
          ...s,
          lastPlayed: Date.now(),
          data: {
            ...s.data,
            selectedPreset,
            messages,
            playerStats,
            playerName,
            playerGender,
            playerAge,
            customStats,
            customWorldDesc
          }
        };
      }
      return s;
    }));
  }, [messages, playerStats, playerName, playerGender, playerAge, customStats, customWorldDesc, selectedPreset, currentSessionId]);

  // 更新当前会话数据 (保留函数名以防万一，但逻辑已由 useEffect 接管)
  const saveGame = () => {
    // 逻辑现在由上方的 useEffect 自动处理
    console.log('Auto-save triggered via useEffect');
  };

  // 自动滚动到底部
  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages, isAiLoading]);

  const printToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMsg(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMsg(prev => prev === msg ? null : prev);
    }, 3000);
  };

  // 4. 开始游戏 (或保存编辑)
  const handleStartCampaign = async () => {
    if (isEditingSession && currentEditingId) {
      // 如果是编辑模式，更新现有会话
      setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => {
        if (s.id === currentEditingId) {
          const updatedStats = {
            ...(s.data.playerStats || {}),
            name: playerName,
            gender: playerGender,
            age: playerAge,
            customStats: [...customStats]
          };
          return {
            ...s,
            data: {
              ...s.data,
              playerName,
              playerGender,
              playerAge,
              customWorldDesc,
              customStats: [...customStats],
              playerStats: updatedStats
            }
          };
        }
        return s;
      }));
      
      // 如果当前正在游玩这个会话，也更新当前状态
      if (currentSessionId === currentEditingId) {
        setPlayerStats(prev => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          name: playerName,
          gender: playerGender,
          age: playerAge,
          customStats: [...customStats]
        } : null);
      }

      printToast(' 剧本信息已更新');
      setGameState('list');
      setIsEditingSession(false);
      setCurrentEditingId(null);
      return;
    }

    // 初始化角色属性
    const initialStats: PlayerStats = {
      location: selectedPreset.defaultLocation,
      atmosphere: selectedPreset.defaultAtmosphere,
      name: playerName,
      gender: playerGender,
      age: playerAge,
      customStats: [...customStats]
    };

    // 创建新会话
    const newSessionId = `session-${Date.now()}`;
    const newSession = {
      id: newSessionId,
      lastPlayed: Date.now(),
